messages:
laura: PTAL — I pushed the changes from review on PR #4823. Addressed the API param rename, added unit + integration tests, and a migration note. CI is running. Can someone eyeball the shard-routing change? https://git.redwood/pr/4823 :pray:
mike: skimmed diff — looks good but one question: the behavior change when header is absent — do we fallback to legacy routing? that's important for canary. not obvious from code.
laura: good catch — yes fallback to legacy routing. I added explicit test and comment in code: // fallback to legacy if x-routing missing
kim: CI flake earlier on e2e, can you re-run smoke after CI passes? will want to run a small load test in staging too.
dev-bot: buildkite — PR #4823 — Pipeline passed (unit,lint) — https://ci.redwood/4823/build/112 :white_check_mark:
laura: thanks — re-ran e2e sweep, pushed a tiny fix to wait for health check. Should be green.
ops: heads up — planning canary window tomorrow 09:00 PT. If this is merged today we can include it. Who will be merge custodian?
mike: I can take merge custodian for this one, available 09:00–10:30 PT. I'll monitor metrics.
laura: awesome, thanks @mike. One more ask: can someone from infra confirm no config migration needed? I left a migration note but it's a noop for existing clusters.
sam: I checked — no cluster changes. migration note is fine.
kim: for manual smoke, run: ```./scripts/smoke.sh --staging --concurrency 20 --duration 2m``` then check /alerts for routing errors. If you want I can join the run.
laura: added the smoke script command to PR description. @kim please join if free.
mike: PTAL — leaving one tiny nit inline (naming). If laura is ok I'll merge after canary slot reserved. :+1:
laura: addressed the nit and squashed. CI green. Tagging for merge: PR ready.
dev-bot: buildkite — All checks passed. Deployer: no conflicts.
kim: :thumbsup: Good to go from e2e side.
laura: merging now. Thanks all. I'll post canary notes in #incidents if anything odd.
